ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance
be amended by changing all the RS-2 Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District

symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 12-J in the area bounded by

A line 50 feet north of and parallel to West 49" Street; the alley next
east of and parallel to South Ridgeway Avenue; West 49" Street; and
South Ridgeway Avenue,

to those of a RS-3 Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage

and due publication.

Common address of property: 4851 South Ridgeway Avenue / 3716 West 49" Street
